summary: Verified new LIS retention Auto-Delete feature + Pengaturan page (koordinator-only) + Light-mode default theme. Full pytest suite (17 tests) covering GET/PUT /api/settings, RBAC, invalid value validation, cleanup deletion of aged rows while preserving recent rows AND pemakaian_harian/stock_period, backfill of uploaded_at on legacy docs, and regression on health/monitoring/lis/users endpoints — all PASSED. Playwright UI test covering: default light theme on fresh load (localStorage cleared), petugas hidden from Pengaturan nav and shown access-denied on direct URL, koordinator sees retention card with default 7 hari, changing to 3 + Simpan shows success toast and persists across reload, reset to 7 works, theme toggle to dark works & persists to ls_theme in localStorage — all PASSED. Retention value left at default 7. Test lis_raw rows cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~1000 lines — consider splitting routes into modules (auth, settings, monitoring, lis, prf) for maintainability (>700 lines guideline).
FastAPI on_event('startup') is deprecated; migrate to lifespan handlers.

_run_lis_retention_cleanup uses ISO-string lt-comparison on 'uploaded_at' which works only because timestamps are UTC ISO with consistent zone suffix — safer to store as native datetime and compare as datetime; document this or migrate.
Cleanup writes an import_log entry every run (even when 0 deleted) → collection grows unbounded over time; consider only logging when deleted>0 or add TTL/prune on import_log cleanup entries.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily inserted 2 lis_raw test rows (source_file='TEST_RETENTION.xlsx', ids TEST_OLD_1/TEST_NEW_1) inside test_cleanup_deletes_old_preserves_new; both cleaned up at end of test. Retention setting toggled to 3 during test then reset to 7.
